pullRequests.title: fix(enhanced): require reciprocal clearance for medial paths
pullRequests.author: llesieur99
pullRequests.head: codex/fix-level11-probe-connection
pullRequests.body:
PAL level 11's enhanced-lighting bake can fail with invalid medial field connection in room 0 (swimming true). The same clearance query returns blocked in one direction and clear in the other, while the medial skeleton stores undirected edges. A later traversal then encounters an edge it cannot validate.
The padded body/head rays now check both directions. Near-ray bias can hide an obstacle immediately beside the reverse ray's origin, so either direction's occlusion must reject the connection.…

commits.headline: fix(enhanced): require reciprocal clearance for medial paths
commits.author: llesieur99
commits.body:
The endpoint overlap and near-ray bias can hide an obstacle in one
direction of a body sweep. The medial graph is undirected, so smoothing
can retain an edge that later fails when simplified from the other end.
Check both directions before accepting its body/head clearance.

The synthetic endpoint-obstacle test fails with the old sweep for both
walking and swimming. With the fix, PAL level 11 bakes all 254 regions
using unchanged traversal settings. Probe-tool Python tests: 117 pass.
